description: She wears an opaque deep rust-red floor-length noble gown with a low square neckline, fitted pointed-front bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold plant and heraldic-looking embroidery decorates the bodice and sleeves, while multicolored red, teal and gold woven borders frame the neckline, skirt opening and hem. A cream patterned underdress is visible down the central skirt opening. A cream wrap with brown-gold patterned edging rests loosely around her forearms and hangs beside the skirt. A fine necklace with a small dark red drop pendant and rings are visible. One dark brown closed-toe leather shoe appears below the skirt. No headgear or weapon is present.
